content.short: Cross-border card-to-card, bank and business payments.
content.description: Paysend is a UK-based global payments platform known for pioneering low-cost, card-to-card international money transfers. From its app, consumers can send money to bank accounts, cards, and wallets across more than 150 countries with transparent fees, while Paysend Business gives companies multi-currency accounts, mass payouts, and tools to pay suppliers and staff abroad. Paysend focuses on migrants, families, and small businesses that need fast, affordable remittances and cross-border payments without the markups of traditional banks. By building its own global network connecting cards, banks, and local payment systems, Paysend delivers quick transfers at flat or low fees, competing with other digital remittance and multi-currency providers for everyday international money movement.
content.meta: Paysend offers low-cost card-to-card and cross-border payments for people and business. Discover Paysend and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
